checks.name: Pinned real engine imports the base project headlessly
Base starts headless with a real viewport and no captured input
Crosshair is a full-rect control centred on the real viewport
Crosshair stays centred across real resolution changes
Resolution changes really reach the engine viewport
Held model keeps its camera-local mount after a real look
Held model moves and turns in world space with the camera
Sword state swaps the model and hides the crosshair from the same state
Sword attack executes melee, uses no ammunition and respects real reach
Switching back restores the gun model, reticle and untouched ammunition
Forward movement is real and the body stays on the floor
Real aim ray hits the centre target with the authored damage
A second immediate shot is blocked by the real cooldown
After the cooldown expires the next shot fires and damages the target
Reload moves real rounds from the reserve into the magazine
Saving writes progress through the real filesystem
Sliding into the range wall stops movement instead of passing through it
A brand new process starts from authored defaults
Restore across a full process restart recovers ammo, equipment and target damage
Restored player position and look match the saved state
A restored world reports the same save on disk
Walking with the sword equipped closes the real distance to the target
Aimed sword melee reports the target inside real reach
Sword melee damages a target inside its real reach
Destroying two targets completes the authored quest
Quest completion grants the reserve and inventory reward exactly once
The HUD shows the live quest and inventory from the same state
Quest progress and the one-time reward survive a full restart
Blank start runs as its own real scene with no targets or interactables
Blank start moves with real physics and fires with no target present
Blank start saves and restores its own world identity
Pointing at the crate produces a real aim result and prompt
Interacting adds real reserve ammunition through EquipmentState
Interactable state and the granted ammunition survive a restart

A newer state version is rejected instead of being guessed at
Rejected states leave the live world completely unchanged
Equipment models resolve to the authored OBJ assets in this project
A ready weapon shows the style colour before any attack
A confirmed hit turns the reticle to the hit colour
A second attack is refused while cooling down
The reticle shows the cooldown colour while the item is cooling down
An attack is refused while reloading
After the reload the reticle returns to the style colour and the magazine is full
An empty magazine refuses the next attack with the empty reason
A no-attack item shows no model and no reticle from the same state
A no-attack item refuses an attack with the no-attack reason
A state that fails on a later block is rejected with a concrete reason
Blocks applied before the failure are rolled back completely
A world with no save of its own cannot read another world progress
Edited source damage applies without discarding saved progress
